original_description: Say what the logo is for, and give a business name only if you want one in the design. It draws the logo, shows you a preview, and hands over the files in a zip — SVG and PNG, as a horizontal lockup plus a square icon for avatars and favicons when there is a name, or a text-free mark when there isn't. Then it can generate a matching B12 website using the same brand colors.
summary_ja: 用途や任意の事業名からロゴを作り、SVG・PNGのZIPを提供し、同じ配色のサイトも作れると説明。
limitations: 実動作、料金、生成物の権利や商用利用条件は未検証。
